observations: Intentional portable source port; original ordinary return spellings, object layouts, inheritance and ARM ABI remain unresolved. FileName aggregate/void are chosen source declarations. No hardware/network/device operations.

Native executes only exact sealed app target ranges; CCL calls and previously reconstructed cache lookup/buildFileName are explicit fixture boundaries. No Core binary reconstruction. The oracle records app memory writes, provider-call traces and ordered notifications. Host supplements these with real CCL tree/archive executions.

Constructor C1/C2 are checked separately and execute separate native ranges; host emits ABI constructor aliases. Native exception cleanup is entered directly at its original landing pad to observe actual application singleton cleanup instructions; original personality/unwinder and provider allocation failure are not emulated. Host uses real thrown new[] failure and actual CCL base destruction.

State stores borrowed typed mixer/manager and the existing ordered mixer mute pointers. Actual MixerComponentBase.saveServices.parameters is the sole storage tree; existing State.loose and State.enabled remain authoritative. Objects and borrowed pointers must remain live/stable; initialized tag0 and non-null mixer mutes required. Reentrant structural mutation, concurrent calls and dangling inputs excluded.

Manager owns only its real CCL Vector storage, never borrowed cache objects. Legacy borrowed-pointer constructor copies the initial ordered pointers into the same single authoritative Vector; input-array alias mutation is not a recovered interface. Growth/allocation-failure semantics come from pinned CCL.

CCL hasTasks counts callback notification entries, not callback-free pending saves. Replay queues an actual ExternalTask callback after each save as the completion barrier and waits at most five seconds before verifying archive data. Production preserves null callback and original zero archive options.

Static safe path is not reset per object. Empty-path retry follows the native empty check; native FileName descend ordinarily makes even a missing-cache result nonempty. Filesystem permission/error injection and overlength/truncated paths are excluded from current fixtures.

Kept historical scripts unchanged, adapted only owned regression runner to explicitly compile current manager/cache dependencies; actual first attempt logs retained in attempt01.
Initial compilation lacked actual FileName include and test used const OutputStorage rather than real provider mutable signature; corrected before validation.

Initial fixture printf boundary mis-modeled UINT_MAX addition as -4294967296 instead of wrapping to zero; corrected independent boundary to uint32 addition then int32 representation. Production cache implementation unchanged.

Initial host async test used hasTasks alone and read before callback-free write completed. Inspected pinned actual provider source; replaced fixture wait with queued real ExternalTask completion barrier. Production flags/null callback retained.
